benchmarks.title: Homogeneous Equivalence (Constant Spatial Field vs Standard Material)
benchmarks.modelDescription: 2-element 1D bar, length L=100mm, A=10mm2, E=200000MPa, load F=5000N
benchmarks.referenceMethod: Closed-form direct elimination FEM without spatial field

benchmarks.title: Graded Bar vs Exact Analytical Reference Solution
benchmarks.modelDescription: 20-element bar, L=100mm, A=2mm2, E(x)=E0(1+alpha*x), E0=100000MPa, alpha=0.02, F=5000N
benchmarks.referenceMethod: Exact continuous integral: Delta = (F / (A*E0*alpha)) * ln(1 + alpha*L)

benchmarks.title: Gradient Reversal Benchmark (Forward vs Reversed Spatial Distribution)
benchmarks.modelDescription: Comparison of E(x) = E0(1+0.02x) vs E(x) = E0(1+0.02(100-x))
benchmarks.referenceMethod: Analytical integration of internal displacement profile: u1(L/2)/u2(L/2) = ln(2)/ln(1.5)

benchmarks.title: Negative Control (Spatial Field vs Homogeneous Baseline)
benchmarks.modelDescription: Comparison between uniform E0=100k and graded field E(x)
benchmarks.referenceMethod: Demonstration that field produces distinct mechanical response (diff > 1.0mm)

benchmarks.title: Mesh Convergence Study (N=4, 8, 16, 32 elements)
benchmarks.modelDescription: Graded bar mesh refinement against exact analytical reference solution

benchmarks.title: Multi-Element 3D Tetrahedral Mesh with Spatial Modulus Gradient
benchmarks.modelDescription: Multi-tetrahedral solid under tip shear with spatial linear modulus gradient and Poisson ratio
benchmarks.referenceMethod: Full 3D sparse PCG solve with reaction force equilibrium check
